project.title: treasure_chest independent right/top artwork
project.description: Two independent full-resolution cameras derived from the reviewed original front ornament design.
project.art_direction: Match the supplied established fish/aquascape illustration for detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART: deliberate fine crisp pixel clusters, coherent painted volume, restrained believable colors and readable material wear. No smooth CGI, photograph, low-poly render, chibi toy, uniform procedural noise or thick black comic outline. One complete isolated object on pure white, generous clean white margin, no floor or cast shadow, no water, fish, plants, text, labels or extra objects. No diagram, collage or packed views. Preserve full native resolution.
project.gameplay_loop: Reconstruct this reviewed ornament and place it freely in the substrate trial.
project.session_goal: Source-consistent right/top donors; visual review before three-dimensional modeling.
project.visual_reference_usage: North-star full-screen mock at project viewport resolution (1024x1024). Align palette, line weight, and mood with art_direction — not pixel-perfect. Do NOT use as img2img input for character/icon sprites; those use assets[].display_size on white studio.

asset.name: treasure_chest_top
asset.description:
Render ONE TOP view of the EXACT SAME designed ornament shown in the supplied FRONT artwork, not a new similar object. Subject: One small closed old wooden treasure chest aquarium ornament, 23 cm wide, 15 cm deep and about 16 cm high. Rectangular thick lower box and a gently domed closed lid with a clear continuous lid seam, two broad dark iron straps over the lid and sides, a small dull brass latch centered on the front. Uneven age-worn wooden planks, muted dark walnut brown with restrained honey exposed edges and dull rusty iron; no skulls, faces, gold coins, jewels, text or handles. Stable short integral corner feet, no detached accessories. Finished naturalistic pixel artwork, not a cartoon reward icon.
Match the supplied established fish/aquascape illustration for detailed naturalistic PIXEL ART: deliberate fine crisp pixel clusters, coherent painted volume, restrained believable colors and readable material wear. No smooth CGI, photograph, low-poly render, chibi toy, uniform procedural noise or thick black comic outline. One complete isolated object on pure white, generous clean white margin, no floor or cast shadow, no water, fish, plants, text, labels or extra objects. No diagram, collage or packed views. Preserve full native resolution.
Strict orthographic TOP PLAN, camera at +Y looking straight down -Y. X horizontal, Z depth vertical; rear -Z is image top and front +Z is image bottom. Height disappears: do not draw the upright facade or a three-quarter/isometric view. For the jar show its open mouth, thick walls and dark cavity with a solid bottom. For ship show its open cargo well and connected low hull; anchor appears as a narrow but finite forged thickness footprint.
Preserve every actual source component, relative proportion, worn edge, opening, material color and landmark as the same physical object from the new direction. Actual reference proportions take priority over approximate descriptive dimensions. Infer hidden surfaces consistently; do not invent extra feet, posts, holes or decorations. Genuine tunnels remain open; jar and cargo-well cavities have solid bottoms. This is one full-resolution camera-specific art donor, no other views or annotations.
